perspective:
**Alice Lim’s accessible information:**

- She knows herself as Alice Lim, a woman, Asian, a dental hygienist, and high-school educated. She is close old friends with Austin from high school; they have different careers, discuss personal/professional lives, and support each other. She knows Austin works in an office/insurance setting through their friendship.
- She directly observed Austin becoming reserved when they talked about work. She invited him to coffee and asked if things were okay at the office. She heard Austin say it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs; after she pressed, he said he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and it was complicated. She believed he might be hiding something about his job performance.
- She believed Austin might be considering a career change due to work dissatisfaction and felt worried. She shared her experiences and discussed healthcare career paths. She asked if he had thought about changing careers. She heard Austin say he had thought about it but didn’t know other paths and asked for suggestions. She told him healthcare needs dedicated people and offered more information and contacts. He said it sounded interesting and wanted to know more.
- She sensed Austin’s hesitation/fear of the unknown and felt frustration plus empathy. She told him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier. She heard Austin say that was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle. She encouraged him about growth through comfort zones and said she supports him. He thanked her and said her support and real success stories helped.
- She felt encouraged and hopeful by his openness. She offered detailed guidance and transition help, suggested a career counselor and friends in healthcare, and said she would set up a meeting next week. She heard Austin say that would be helpful and he appreciated the connections. He thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, she believed Austin was ready for next steps and appreciated her help; she felt satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud, asked how he felt, and heard him say he felt excited, nervous, and grateful. She said that was normal and proposed regular check-ins. He agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that he valued her perspective.
